name: Goma neutral Tier-3/Tier-4 data center plan (PNN Horizon 2025)
developer: Government of the DRC / Agence pour le Developpement du Numerique
notes: Plan National du Numerique Horizon 2025 project 10 calls for at least five neutral Tier-3/Tier-4 data centers in urban centres including Goma. Re-verified 2026-08-12: no confirmed construction or operational Goma facility found in method-driven searches (Goma data center RDC, Goma IXP/point d'echange, Goma centre de donnees, ADN Goma); Goma also appears as a directory 'key location' on datacenters.com DRC page (C-grade lead only). Console Connect Africa Interconnection Report 2025 flags a Goma local IXP as interconnection context, not a facility. Policy lead only; keep planned until site/tender/build evidence appears.

name: Kisangani neutral Tier-3/Tier-4 data center plan (PNN Horizon 2025)

Policy lead only; keep planned until named tender/site/build evidence appears.
